body: Session-scoped declarativeNetRequest rule with a tabIds condition that sets the Authorization header. Note: tabIds works ONLY on session rules (updateSessionRules), and header modification needs host permissions. PASS: two tabs on the same origin receive different bearer tokens, confirmed server-side, and the behaviour survives an MV3 service-worker teardown. Also validates the DNR plumbing every other option reuses.
title: S2 — per-tab Authorization injection (cheap path)
